text:
Rina: Quick voting emergency: our conference room plant needs a name. Ideas? :seedling:
Omar: 'Photosynthesize This' is a mood. :joy:
Leah: We should name it after someone who never takes Slack messages offline. 'Always-On Alan'?
Ben: Vote by replying with a one-liner. Winner gets naming rights and a decorative sticky star.
Rina: Tiny haiku optional bonus points. I'll start: 'Quiet green witness / Meetings breathe, leaves note the time / Coffee keeps her warm.'
Omar: One-liner: 'Fern-tastic neutral party.' :star2:
Leah: Haiku attempt: 'Sunbeam on the sill / Passive-aggressive growth spurt / Pots are full of hope.'
Ben: Sprite-bot: Reminder: please water plants on Tuesdays. Calendar invite sent.
Rina: Voting so far: Omar for humor, Leah for poetry. Drop your vote (name or emoji) by 5pm.
Omar: Also, anyone seen the blue mug with a constellation sticker? Asking for a friend.
Leah: I saw it by the sink yesterday. Left a polite Post-it 'Rescue mug?'.
Ben: Whoever finds it can whisper the plant name suggestion and claim the sticky star. :trophy:
Rina: Final push: best tiny haiku gets extra sticker. Plant name suggestions accepted: 'Boardroom Betty', 'Meeting Myrtle', 'Agenda Agave'.
Omar: Cast vote: Meeting Myrtle ✅
Leah: Cast vote: Boardroom Betty ✅
Ben: Cast vote: Meeting Myrtle. "Meeting Myrtle" wins! Sticker ceremony at 4:55.
Rina: Thanks everyone. Myrtle will be watered and protected. And the blue mug: it's in Lost & Found - bring ID. :sparkles:
